m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Okay, Nimbari, hold tight here until the Wizard and I have cleared the way. Let's go Wizard!
Aaaaahhh! Parasites! Parasites have infested the ecosystem! Sound the alarms!
So much for stealth. Nimbari, hurry up.
I have closed the Left Eye and I can secure this station against the Cabal. You two should make haste.
Good job, Sparck. C'mon, Wizard. Let's go grab Pork.
I'll hang back here and... um... stretch. Wouldn't want to pull a hammy when my number's called. Good luck, everyone!
Good thinking, Pork. Wizard, if you need to stretch too, just be quick and meet us at the door to the Left Optical Nerve. Follow me, Sparck!
Is that an alarm? How's Sparck? Bat, if you lost one of my Crewmen...
Sparck's fine. He has the Left Eye under control. But the Cabal did raise the alarm. So we're going to have to adjust the plan.
Y'ar, mayhaps I might proffer a suggestion?
What ye need is a bit o' what we in the sailing biz call misdirection.
We need to close Sepidious' eyes. Let's start with the Left Eye. Sparck, why don't you assist us on this one.
